# WC3 · Thêm người bệnh

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · modal · Next.js: **none** · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#modalHtml`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `data-modal="patient"` → `modalHtml('patient')`; `action('create-patient')` saves a synthetic profile and toasts "Đã tạo hồ sơ demo"; an empty name toasts "Nhập tên người bệnh".
- Page key `patients` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"[data-modal=\"patient\"]"} → {"wait":".modal-backdrop .modal"}; it must show "Thêm người bệnh".

## Layout (top to bottom, from the web canvas frame, region → src/ui component)
Generated from the blocks of `Pema Web redesign canvas/Pema Web.dc.html` (frame WC3): every block is one kit component or web block (see BLOCKS.md). Names, numbers and money are the canvas sample data; labels, actions, statuses, filters and notices are the old web's, verbatim. The old web's own tree is under "Old web snapshot".
```tsx
// opens over the page "Tìm bệnh nhân" (dimmed); the page behind it is not part of this screen
<Dialog eyebrow="Hồ sơ mới · demo" title="Thêm người bệnh" width="640px">
  <Dialog.Close aria-label="Đóng hộp thoại" icon="close">"×"</Dialog.Close>
  <Grid cols="repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))" gap="16px">
    <Field label="Họ và tên" type="text" placeholder="Nguyễn ..." />
    <Field label="Tuổi" type="number" default="28" />
  </Grid>
  <Field label="Mối quan tâm" type="text" default="Nám · tăng sắc tố" />
  <Dialog.Footer>
    <Button variant="primary">"Tạo hồ sơ"</Button>
  </Dialog.Footer>
</Dialog>
```
Kit components used: Field×3, Dialog×1, Button×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.

## Differences from the app design
- No Next.js dialog yet although the API POST /patients exists. Fix needed, PARITY-AI01-U section 5.

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
- Canvas: the dialog close button (old aria-label "Đóng hộp thoại") is drawn by the dlg helper as an icon; the generated Layout does not name it, so the label is exempted through demo_data.
